meta.description: Thin-wall GCR response kernel R=D_organ/Phi_ff, cal_material=aluminium. Regenerated by lunarsim.kernel_gen.
meta.quantity: R = D_organ / Phi_ff  (Gy*cm^2); q in D=absorbed, I=ICRP-60 dose-eq
meta.note: COMPOSITION=perelement: 10 ions (H/He/C/N/O/Ne/Mg/Si/Ca/Fe) carried INDIVIDUALLY, replacing the 5 Z^2-lumped reps. Each ion has its own single-element Matthiae-2013 spectrum AND its own Geant4 fragmentation; abundances are Voronoi per-element sums over Z=1-28 (every Z assigned to its nearest carried ion, so the total GCR flux is conserved exactly). Folded with LUNARSIM_GCR_PERELEMENT=perelement so the LIS read is element-aware. Built to resolve the thin-wall <Q> over-read (memory let-scorer-thin-qbar-rootcause). COMPOSITION=corrected: H/He/C/Si/Fe matching dosimetry.GCR_COMPOSITION (doc 2.3). Si (Z=14) is the Z=10-20 (Ne-Ca) group representative, replacing the committed kernel's O. Fe is regridded to the 6-node C/Si grid [180-5000 MeV/n] from the committed 3-node [400-1000], which folded only ~31% of the Fe GCR fluence. H/He/C transport is identical to the committed kernel (--validate confirms); Si and Fe are new MC. COMPOSITION=corrected: H/He/C/Si/Fe matching dosimetry.GCR_COMPOSITION (doc 2.3).
